dx_essential_hypertension.title: Essential hypertension
dx_essential_hypertension.description: SNOMED essential (primary) hypertension and all standard descendants. Excludes secondary hypertension.
dx_essential_hypertension.clinical_rationale: Defines the primary diagnosis used to set tdx (latency endpoint) for target cohort T.

dx_secondary_hypertension.title: Secondary hypertension
dx_secondary_hypertension.description: SNOMED Secondary hypertension parent and descendants (renovascular, endocrine, drug-induced).
dx_secondary_hypertension.clinical_rationale: Excluded from target cohort T to keep the population to incident essential HTN.

dx_primary_aldosteronism.title: Primary aldosteronism
dx_primary_aldosteronism.description: SNOMED primary hyperaldosteronism subtypes (adrenal adenoma, hyperplasia, malignant) and descendants.
dx_primary_aldosteronism.clinical_rationale: Outcome of the aldosterone-testing follow-up analysis (J).

dx_ckd.title: Chronic kidney disease
dx_ckd.description: SNOMED Chronic kidney disease (parent) and all standard descendants including ESRD.

dx_abnormal_kidney_function.title: Abnormal kidney function (CKD + AKI)
dx_abnormal_kidney_function.description: Composite of chronic kidney disease (CKD parent) and acute kidney injury, with descendants.
dx_abnormal_kidney_function.clinical_rationale: Target cohort T excludes patients with any prior abnormal kidney function (CKD + AKI).

dx_mi.title: Myocardial infarction
dx_mi.description: SNOMED Myocardial infarction (parent) and standard descendants including acute MI subtypes (STEMI, NSTEMI).

dx_stroke.title: Stroke (ischemic and hemorrhagic)
dx_stroke.description: SNOMED Cerebrovascular accident, Cerebral infarction, Subarachnoid hemorrhage, Intracranial hemorrhage parents and descendants.

dx_heart_failure.title: Heart failure
dx_heart_failure.description: SNOMED Heart failure parent (includes chronic HF, acute HF, HF with reduced/preserved ejection fraction) and descendants. Visit qualifier (inpatient) applied at the cohort SQL level.
dx_heart_failure.clinical_rationale: MACE composite outcome component (O1) — visit-qualified inpatient hospitalization required at cohort level per open question Q8 default.

dx_thyroid_disease.title: Thyroid disease (hyper- and hypothyroidism)
dx_thyroid_disease.description: SNOMED Disorder of thyroid gland parent and descendants (hyper-, hypothyroidism, thyroiditis).
dx_thyroid_disease.clinical_rationale: Target cohort T excludes thyroid disease (secondary HTN cause).

dx_prior_cv_disease.title: Prior cardiovascular disease (composite)
dx_prior_cv_disease.description: Composite of MI, stroke (ischemic/hemorrhagic), heart failure, peripheral vascular disease, and post-CABG/PCI status. Conditions only; CABG and PCI procedures are tracked separately.
dx_prior_cv_disease.clinical_rationale: Target cohort T excludes patients with any prior CVD to ensure incident-event interpretation of outcomes.

lab_sbp.title: Systolic blood pressure (LOINC)
lab_sbp.description: Systolic blood pressure LOINC concept and standard descendants.
lab_sbp.clinical_rationale: Defines the index-event measurement (one half of the consecutive-elevated-BP rule).

lab_dbp.title: Diastolic blood pressure (LOINC)
lab_dbp.description: Diastolic blood pressure LOINC concept and standard descendants.
lab_dbp.clinical_rationale: Defines the index-event measurement (other half of the consecutive-elevated-BP rule).

lab_cbc_panel.title: Complete blood count panel (LOINC)
lab_cbc_panel.description: LOINC CBC panel parent and descendants.

lab_cmp_panel.title: Comprehensive metabolic panel (LOINC)
lab_cmp_panel.description: LOINC CMP panel parent and descendants (sodium, potassium, creatinine, eGFR, BUN, glucose, calcium, liver enzymes).

lab_lipid_panel.title: Lipid panel (LOINC)
lab_lipid_panel.description: LOINC Lipid panel parent and descendants (LDL, HDL, total cholesterol, triglycerides).

lab_aldosterone.title: Aldosterone and plasma renin activity (LOINC)
lab_aldosterone.description: Aldosterone serum (LOINC 1763-2) and plasma renin activity (LOINC 2915-7) — both needed for ARR.
lab_aldosterone.clinical_rationale: Baseline lab ordering and aldosterone-to-PA follow-up analysis (J).

lab_tsh.title: TSH (Thyrotropin, LOINC)
lab_tsh.clinical_rationale: Baseline lab ordering analysis (J) — screens for thyroid disease.

rx_antihypertensives_all.title: Antihypertensives (ATC C02-C09, broad)
rx_antihypertensives_all.description: Standard drug concepts descending from ATC C02 (antihypertensives), C03 (diuretics), C07 (beta-blockers), C08 (CCB), C09 (RAAS agents). Broad scope per open question Q5 default.
rx_antihypertensives_all.clinical_rationale: Target cohort T excludes any prior antihypertensive exposure (treatment-naive criterion).

rx_diuretics.title: Diuretics (ATC C03)
rx_diuretics.description: ATC C03 diuretics — thiazides, loops, K-sparing, MRA.

rx_acei_arb.title: ACE inhibitors and ARBs (ATC C09)
rx_acei_arb.description: ATC C09 — agents acting on the renin-angiotensin system.

rx_ccb.title: Calcium channel blockers (ATC C08)
rx_ccb.description: ATC C08 calcium channel blockers — dihydropyridines and non-dihydropyridines.

rx_beta_blocker.title: Beta-blockers (ATC C07)
rx_beta_blocker.description: ATC C07 beta-blocking agents — selective and non-selective.

rx_mra.title: Mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists (ATC C03DA)
rx_mra.description: ATC C03DA aldosterone antagonists — spironolactone, eplerenone.
rx_mra.clinical_rationale: Resistant-HTN add-on class (S1) and primary aldosteronism treatment.

rx_central_alpha_agonist.title: Central alpha-agonists (ATC C02A)
rx_central_alpha_agonist.description: ATC C02A centrally acting antiadrenergic agents — clonidine, methyldopa, guanfacine.

device_home_bp_monitor.title: Home blood pressure monitor (HCPCS)
device_home_bp_monitor.description: HCPCS automatic BP monitor device code (A4670) and descendants.
device_home_bp_monitor.clinical_rationale: Home BP monitoring as evidence of clinician awareness of BP elevation (informs latency analysis).

lab_egfr.title: eGFR (estimated glomerular filtration rate, LOINC)
lab_egfr.description: All standard eGFR LOINC concepts: MDRD (race- and sex-stratified), CKD-EPI, CKD-EPI 2021, Cystatin-C based, panel concepts. Cohort SQL applies value_as_number < 60 threshold.
lab_egfr.clinical_rationale: Baseline kidney exclusion per Dr. Bock (Q11): exclude any pre-index eGFR < 60 (Stage 3+ CKD).

dx_pregnancy.title: Pregnancy (diagnosis)
dx_pregnancy.description: SNOMED Pregnancy parent and standard descendants (gestational states, normal pregnancy variants).
dx_pregnancy.clinical_rationale: Lu 2025 replication exclusion (T_lu). Not used in primary T cohort.

proc_dialysis.title: Dialysis procedures
proc_dialysis.description: SNOMED Renal dialysis, hemodialysis, peritoneal dialysis procedures and descendants.
proc_dialysis.clinical_rationale: Lu 2025 replication exclusion (T_lu). Also a stronger marker of advanced CKD for the primary cohort kidney exclusion.
